lines.zh: 我一步一步踩在草地上，很沉
lines.en: I tread the grass, heavy step by step

lines.zh: 四条腿走得稳，背上却不太对
lines.en: Four legs walk steady, but something on my back is wrong

lines.zh: 我走得像牛，可这步子太整齐
lines.en: I walk like a cow, but too evenly

lines.zh: 草场的风把味道吹乱了
lines.en: The pasture wind muddles the scents

lines.zh: 我在这片草地走了很多趟
lines.en: I have crossed this pasture many times

lines.zh: 头低着，眼睛却一直抬着
lines.en: My head is down, my eyes stay up

lines.zh: 蹄子下陷了半寸，土是软的
lines.en: My hooves sink half an inch, the soil is soft

lines.zh: 我绕开牛群，走自己的路
lines.en: I go around the herd and take my own way

lines.zh: 嘴角有点湿，不是草汁
lines.en: Something wet at my mouth, not grass juice

lines.zh: 我一边走一边数着人
lines.en: I count the people as I walk

lines.zh: 影子是四条腿的，可动作不像
lines.en: The shadow has four legs, but the movement is wrong

lines.zh: 走一步，身上的皮就紧一分
lines.en: Each step, the hide on me tightens

lines.zh: 我站着反刍，嘴里什么也没有
lines.en: I stand chewing, with nothing in my mouth

lines.zh: 这身皮不太合身
lines.en: This hide does not fit quite right

lines.zh: 我低着头，草就在嘴边
lines.en: My head is low, the grass right at my mouth

lines.zh: 我不吃，我等着
lines.en: I do not eat, I wait

lines.zh: 牛群离我十步远
lines.en: The herd stays ten paces off

lines.zh: 我听见有脚步声，就往那边偏头
lines.en: I hear steps and tilt toward them

lines.zh: 皮下面的东西在动
lines.en: Something under the hide moves

lines.zh: 我把自己摆成一个姿势
lines.en: I arrange myself into a pose

lines.zh: 一只苍蝇落在我背上，我没赶
lines.en: A fly landed on my back, I did not swat it

lines.zh: 这样站着，没人看出问题
lines.en: Standing like this, nobody notices anything

lines.zh: 嘴边的口水滴在草上
lines.en: Drool drips onto the grass

lines.zh: 我一直在看你们的反应
lines.en: I keep watching how you react

lines.zh: 呼吸很轻，牛不该这么轻
lines.en: My breathing is light, a cow should not be this light

lines.zh: 我又往里缩了一点
lines.en: I retract a little deeper

lines.zh: 你走过来的时候，我没有动
lines.en: You walked over and I did not move

lines.zh: 我的眼睛长在两侧，看着你正好
lines.en: My eyes sit at the sides, perfect for watching you

lines.zh: 你摸过牛，可你摸过我吗
lines.en: You have petted cows, but have you petted me

lines.zh: 我这一身皮，颜色是不是有点深
lines.en: Is the color of this hide a little too dark

lines.zh: 你叫了一声，我听见了，不回答
lines.en: You called, I heard, I do not answer

lines.zh: 你再靠近，我就往前一步
lines.en: Come closer and I take one step forward

lines.zh: 我看你，是因为你也在看我
lines.en: I look at you because you are looking at me

lines.zh: 嘴角的口水，我先收一收
lines.en: Let me wipe this drool first

lines.zh: 你手伸出来，是摸还是抓
lines.en: That hand out, is it a touch or a grab

lines.zh: 你分得清我和旁边那头吗
lines.en: Can you tell me from the one beside me

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，这一点不太像牛
lines.en: I do not blink, which is not very cow-like

lines.zh: 你退了，我知道为什么
lines.en: You backed off, and I know why

lines.zh: 这一片草场，就你最像食物
lines.en: In this pasture, you look most like food

lines.zh: 你站在那儿三分钟了
lines.en: You have stood there three minutes

lines.zh: 我要是哞一声，你会放心吗
lines.en: If I mooed, would you relax

lines.zh: 我抬起头，比你高出一截
lines.en: I lift my head, taller than you by a measure

lines.zh: 你的手指在抖，我看见了
lines.en: Your fingers are trembling, I saw

lines.zh: 我们之间只有一道木栏
lines.en: Only a wooden fence is between us

lines.zh: 皮破了一块，底下的东西露出来
lines.en: The hide tore, what is under it shows

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，学得不太像
lines.en: I cried out, and the imitation was poor

lines.zh: 我退了半步，装成受伤的牛
lines.en: I step back, playing an injured cow

lines.zh: 这一下打穿了皮
lines.en: That punch went through the hide

lines.zh: 我低着头，血从嘴里出来
lines.en: My head hangs, blood comes from my mouth

lines.zh: 痛让我忘了姿势
lines.en: The pain made me forget the pose

lines.zh: 你打得我露了破绽
lines.en: You forced a flaw out of me

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，皮歪了
lines.en: I shook and the hide slipped

lines.zh: 这一身装束，不太好修
lines.en: This costume is not easily mended

lines.zh: 牛不会这样叫，我记住了
lines.en: Cows do not cry like that, noted

lines.zh: 草？我不吃这个
lines.en: Grass? That is not for me

lines.zh: 你手里那点青草，引不动我
lines.en: That handful of grass will not lure me

lines.zh: 我不吃，但我可以装吃
lines.en: I do not eat, but I can pretend to

lines.zh: 你把草举高，我就当你在喂
lines.en: Hold it up and I will act as if you are feeding me

lines.zh: 我低头凑近，闻的是你
lines.en: I lower my head and sniff you, not it

lines.zh: 这么点草，够谁吃
lines.en: That little grass, who is it for

lines.zh: 我张嘴，草掉在地上
lines.en: I open my mouth and the grass falls

lines.zh: 你手上的味道，比草好闻
lines.en: What is on your hand smells better than grass

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我就不装了
lines.en: One step back and I stop pretending

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只是想让你靠近
lines.en: I am not hungry, I only want you closer

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我的皮没动
lines.en: You hit me and my hide did not shift

lines.zh: 我顶了一下，力气比牛大
lines.en: I pushed back, harder than a cow should

lines.zh: 别从侧面靠，那里看得见缝
lines.en: Do not come at my flank, the seam shows

lines.zh: 这一碰，我身上的皮皱了
lines.en: That wrinkled the hide on me

lines.zh: 你被弹开的时候还没明白
lines.en: You bounced off before you understood

lines.zh: 我的角是钝的，我别的不是
lines.en: My horns are blunt, other parts of me are not

lines.zh: 我退了半步，装得像个受惊的牛
lines.en: I stepped back, feigning a startled cow

lines.zh: 这一下，牛群里乱了
lines.en: The herd stirred at that

lines.zh: 再撞，我就不装了
lines.en: Bump me again and I stop pretending

lines.zh: 牛群里的事，我懂
lines.en: I understand the ways of the herd

lines.zh: 可这身皮下面不是牛
lines.en: But under this hide, I am not a cow

lines.zh: 你靠近就是让我靠近
lines.en: Your coming close is my coming close

lines.zh: 我低头，像在打招呼
lines.en: I lower my head as if greeting

lines.zh: 这身皮太紧，做不了什么
lines.en: This hide is too tight for anything

lines.zh: 隔壁那头牛一直躲我
lines.en: The cow next to me keeps away

lines.zh: 我学了很久才会反刍
lines.en: It took me long to learn to chew cud

lines.zh: 我这张牛皮下，牙齿不是用来吃草的。
lines.en: Under this cow hide, my teeth aren't for grass.

lines.zh: 这一点，我学不来
lines.en: That, I cannot learn

lines.zh: 我站到天亮，也就是站着
lines.en: I stand until dawn, and standing is all it is

lines.zh: 我低下头，闻了闻
lines.en: I lower my head and sniff

lines.zh: 这东西不能吃
lines.en: This cannot be eaten

lines.zh: 我用舌头卷起来
lines.en: I curl it up with my tongue

lines.zh: 嘴里没有味道
lines.en: There is no taste in my mouth

lines.zh: 它掉下去，沾了泥
lines.en: It fell and got muddy

lines.zh: 你捡的时候，我盯着你的手
lines.en: While you pick it up, I watch your hand

lines.zh: 牛不会捡东西，我知道
lines.en: Cows do not pick things up, I know

lines.zh: 所以我从不捡这种东西
lines.en: Which is why I never pick such things up

lines.zh: 你放那儿，我记着位置
lines.en: Leave it there, I have the spot noted

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的味道了
lines.en: I have your scent now

lines.zh: 我的头转过去，很慢
lines.en: My head turns toward you, slowly

lines.zh: 你走的那条路，我盯着
lines.en: I am watching the path you took

lines.zh: 这片草场不大，三十步就到边
lines.en: This pasture is small, thirty paces to the edge

lines.zh: 我不追不喊，我走过去
lines.en: I do not chase or shout, I walk over

lines.zh: 你听见的蹄声，间隔不对
lines.en: The hoofbeats you hear are evenly spaced

lines.zh: 我看准了你的腿
lines.en: I have fixed on your legs

lines.zh: 这一下，别指望我温和
lines.en: Do not expect gentleness now

lines.zh: 身上的皮开始发烫
lines.en: The hide on me is getting hot

lines.zh: 你回头的时候，我正在抬头
lines.en: When you look back, I am raising my head

lines.zh: 三十步，对四条腿不算远
lines.en: Thirty paces is not far on four legs

lines.zh: 你已经进了我这一片
lines.en: You have stepped into my patch

lines.zh: 我不需要跑，我不需要急
lines.en: I need not run, I need not rush

lines.zh: 你现在明白牛群为什么躲我了
lines.en: Now you know why the herd avoids me

lines.zh: 我的角朝下低了半寸
lines.en: My horns have lowered half an inch

lines.zh: 这一次我不用装
lines.en: This time I do not have to pretend

lines.zh: 我跟着你，不快也不慢
lines.en: I follow, neither fast nor slow

lines.zh: 你翻过木栏，我照样过得去
lines.en: Climb the fence, I will still get through

lines.zh: 我的蹄声一直在一个节奏上
lines.en: My hoofbeats stay at one tempo

lines.zh: 草场边上没有遮蔽
lines.en: There is no cover at the pasture's edge

lines.zh: 你朝村子跑，那条路我更熟
lines.en: You run for the village, I know that road better

lines.zh: 我绕到前面去，从正面来
lines.en: I circle ahead and come from the front

lines.zh: 你跑向牛群，正好
lines.en: You are running to the herd, perfect

lines.zh: 我混在牛群里，就找不到了
lines.en: I blend into the herd and am gone

lines.zh: 你听见的全是蹄声
lines.en: All you hear is hooves

lines.zh: 我离你很近了，你还没回头
lines.en: I am very close and you have not turned

lines.zh: 这一片是我的地方
lines.en: This stretch is mine

lines.zh: 你越跑，我越稳
lines.en: The more you run, the steadier I get

lines.zh: 我不喘，牛会喘，我不会
lines.en: I do not pant, cows do, I do not

lines.zh: 皮已经松了，得快点
lines.en: The hide has loosened, I must be quick

lines.zh: 你的气味在草里留着
lines.en: Your scent lingers in the grass

lines.zh: 前面那道沟，你过不去
lines.en: That ditch ahead, you will not clear it

lines.zh: 我贴着地走，影子很低
lines.en: I keep low, my shadow is small

lines.zh: 我们之间只剩几步
lines.en: Only a few steps are left between us

lines.zh: 我低头一顶，你没站稳
lines.en: I lower my head and butt, you lose your feet

lines.zh: 这一下用的是角根
lines.en: That blow came from the base of the horn

lines.zh: 我的前腿抬起来，比你想的重
lines.en: My foreleg lifts, heavier than you think

lines.zh: 你被撞进了草里
lines.en: You are knocked into the grass

lines.zh: 嘴里咬下去，牙是平的
lines.en: I bite down, my teeth are flat

lines.zh: 皮下面伸出来一点东西
lines.en: Something reaches out from under the hide

lines.zh: 你挡了角，没挡蹄
lines.en: You blocked the horns, not the hooves

lines.zh: 这一撞，木栏都断了
lines.en: That smash broke the fence

lines.zh: 你退到栅栏边，跑不了了
lines.en: You are at the fence and out of room

lines.zh: 我压下来，草都折了
lines.en: I bear down and the grass folds

lines.zh: 蹄子落在你脚边，差一点
lines.en: My hoof landed by your foot, barely missing

lines.zh: 你听见皮裂的声音了吗
lines.en: Did you hear the hide tear

lines.zh: 我甩头，把你往边上带
lines.en: I swing my head and drag you aside

lines.zh: 这一招是学来的
lines.en: This move I learned

lines.zh: 你身上多了两道印子
lines.en: You have two new marks on you

lines.zh: 我往后退了半步，又冲上来
lines.en: I back half a step and charge again

lines.zh: 草场里多了一头牛
lines.en: There is one more cow in the pasture

lines.zh: 它和其他牛站着，但没在吃草
lines.en: It stands with the others but does not graze

lines.zh: 蹄子落下的时候，草压得很平
lines.en: The grass flattens hard under its hooves

lines.zh: 颜色深了一点，我改不了
lines.en: A shade too dark, I cannot help it

lines.zh: 牛群里多了一张脸
lines.en: One more face in the herd

lines.zh: 我从栏外走进来，没有声音
lines.en: I came in over the fence without a sound

lines.zh: 风吹过，我的味道和我旁边不一样
lines.en: The wind blows and my scent differs from the one beside me

lines.zh: 我挑了个靠边的位置站着
lines.en: I chose a spot at the edge

lines.zh: 没有牛看我，它们都知道
lines.en: No cow looks at me, they all know

lines.zh: 我低头，先学了一口草
lines.en: I lower my head and learn a mouthful of grass

lines.zh: 这片草场，从今天起多一个
lines.en: This pasture has one more from today

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，四条腿一起
lines.en: I land on all four legs at once

lines.zh: 栏里的牛往边上挪了挪
lines.en: The cattle in the pen shifted aside

lines.zh: 太阳照在我背上，皮有点反光
lines.en: The sun on my back makes the hide shine

lines.zh: 我不叫，牛会叫，我不叫
lines.en: I do not low, cows low, I do not

lines.zh: 我在等你转过身来
lines.en: I am waiting for you to turn around

lines.zh: 这一堆牛里，有一头不对
lines.en: One in this herd is not right

lines.zh: 我站定了，假装嚼了两口
lines.en: I settle and pretend to chew twice

lines.zh: 火烧到毛皮上，气味很怪
lines.en: Fire caught the fur and the smell is strange

lines.zh: 四条腿落地，我听见骨头响
lines.en: Four legs landed and I heard bones

lines.zh: 水把我这一身浸沉了
lines.en: Water weighed this hide down

lines.zh: 炸得皮都翻了起来
lines.en: The blast rolled the hide back

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我肩头
lines.en: An arrow sank into my shoulder

lines.zh: 那股力气照出我的样子
lines.en: That force showed what I really am

lines.zh: 我早就饿，只是不说
lines.en: I have been hungry a long while, I just do not say

lines.zh: 雷光下，我的影子不像牛
lines.en: Under the lightning my shadow is not a cow's

lines.zh: 这里没有草，四条腿站不稳
lines.en: No grass here, and four legs will not hold
